name: Foma Fomapan 400 Action
notes: Foma datasheet 'FOMAPAN 400 Action', 2 pages, vector (page 1: data and plots; page 2: development time curves). No publication number is printed; the date is the footer code 'FOMA 04/23' on page 2. Speed ISO 400/27 deg (27 deg CSN), panchromatic.

curves: page 1, 'Characteristic curves', exposure Daylight 5500 K, 1/20 s, developer Microphen at 20 C, three curves 1 = 7 min, 2 = 9 min, 3 = 11 min. x axis is 'Log rel. exposure' (relative, no absolute lux-seconds; labelled -3, -2, -1 with the frame edge at 0, calibrated on those grid lines), y is density (0 to 3). Curves are traced from the vector paths; they start at the left frame edge (log rel. exposure -3.2) and stop at about -0.35 (D 2.09, 2.60, 2.94).

v is the 9 min curve: the sheet lists Microphen stock 8-9 min at 20 C (9 min is the plotted time inside that range; 7 min is below it). The others are v-microphen-7 and v-microphen-11. The sheet marks no curve as standard.

The three curve drawings are numerically identical to those in the Fomapan 100 Classic and 200 Creative sheets (same density at every log H relative to the labelled grid lines; they are labelled 5/7/11 and 4/6/8 min there), only the time labels differ, so they may be one reused drawing rather than a measurement of this film. Traced as printed.

sensitivity: page 1, 'Relative spectral sensitivity (wedge spectrogram at 2850 K)', a plotted curve (vector) with axis label S-lambda and no numbers or units on the y axis, so it is not known whether it is linear or logarithmic. y here is the fraction of the frame height (0 = bottom of the frame, 1 = top), nothing more; do not read it as log sensitivity without checking. x grid lines every 50 nm; the printed labels sit about 5 pt right of their lines and the lines are taken as 400, 500, 600, 700 nm (labels are not centred on the lines, so the wavelength scale is uncertain by up to about 10 nm). The curve starts at 400 nm (frame edge), peaks near 670 nm and falls steeply to the frame bottom at about 697 nm.

Grain: RMS 17.5 (Microphen at 20 C, developed to gamma = 0.6, measured at D = 1.0); aperture not stated. Resolving power 90 lines/mm. Schwarzschild effect table and development time table (Microphen stock 8-9 min at 20 C, 3.5 min at 30 C) on page 1.
